fusions.name: Grille Throw
fusions.desc: Throws an iron grille at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It stuns the target for 1.5 seconds, and the target moves 30% slower for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Portcullis Drop
fusions.desc: Drops a gate across the front, which deals 30 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Standstill
fusions.desc: After a 1-second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 4 seconds, then leaves each of them moving 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Warden's Side
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour is 10% higher.
